prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1443; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was backing out of a parking spot at a grocery store in Pasadena, Texas, moving slowly with my foot on the brake, when another car came around the end of the row and struck the rear passenger side of my vehicle. I stopped right away, checked on the other driver, and waited for the police report to be filed. I have described what happened the same way every time I have spoken about it, whether to the officer at the scene, to the adjuster, or to the medical staff who saw me afterward. I am the named driver on this policy and I own the vehicle involved. Since the collision I have had neck pain and stiffness that fits a whiplash injury, along with headaches for several days. I am attending physical therapy and following my doctor's instructions, and I am providing copies of all my medical bills and receipts with this form.
